description: Registry keys that name the machine-internal refs (refs/heads/<value>): the lock and log refs the train and the runner write through forge_git_ref, one record commit each. A push whose every ref is one of them and whose every new commit is a record (a tree of record.json alone) skips the pre-push checks: it carries no code, and on the e2-micro the checks outlast train.git_timeout_s (D-091). Any other ref, or a record ref carrying anything but a record, is checked in full.
